size_note: closed 90 x 48 x 27 mm (teltarif; GSMArena 28 mm deep). The open length is measured on the Mobile Phone Museum's straight-on shot of the open phone. The museum lays flips on their backs: the base lies flat and sets the scale (its width = the spec width); the lid is raised toward the camera, so it is corrected for its tilt (from the display window's proportions, cos 0.944) and its magnification (it shows 1.02x the base's width): about 174 mm. A photo of the open phone leaning on a wall (Wikimedia Commons, Beamish4) gives 170-173 mm

screen.note: w/h from the diagonal at the native aspect, x centred; y = top edge, measured on the geometry photo (the window less its border)

seams.note: lower edge of the top half
top edge of the keypad half (the hinge barrel between)

key_icons: Oval silver-white keys with a thin outline in three columns, each digit with its small blue letters to its right. The 1 key also shows a small envelope and voicemail icon; the * key shows a/A; the 0 key shows '+'; the # key shows a small space symbol.
keypad_labels: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PQRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXYZ
